checks.title: Type scale ratio holds
checks.summary: 100 percent of text sits on a 1.25 scale from 12.8px; 0 sizes do not.

checks.title: Spacing on the grid
checks.summary: 100 percent of spacing lands on a 4px grid; 0 values across 0 sizes do not.

checks.title: No em-dashes in copy
checks.summary: No em-dashes in the visible copy.

checks.title: Heading order
checks.summary: Every page has one h1 and no skipped levels.

checks.title: Landmarks
checks.summary: Every page has one main and a nav or banner.

judgment.title: One lit thing per view
judgment.rule: A view has one glowing accent. The glow is an emission cue and only reads once.
judgment.why: Which element is the hero is a design decision the sheet cannot know.
judgment.summary: Judgment: Which element is the hero is a design decision the sheet cannot know.

judgment.title: Glass on small floating surfaces only
judgment.rule: Translucent glass sits on navs, menus and pills, never on a whole page or a reading surface.
judgment.why: Surface size depends on the page, not the sheet.
judgment.summary: Judgment: Surface size depends on the page, not the sheet.

judgment.title: Motion comes from the center outward
judgment.rule: Entrances assemble from the middle of the composition toward its edges, eased, never cut in.
judgment.why: Choreography lives in the page runtime; the sheet only ships the curve and the durations.
judgment.summary: Judgment: Choreography lives in the page runtime; the sheet only ships the curve and the durations.

judgment.title: Type weight is light to medium
judgment.rule: Nothing is set heavier than 500 except a number in a readout.
judgment.why: Weight is a convention the sheet follows but a page can override; there is no fixed threshold that holds for every face.
judgment.summary: Judgment: Weight is a convention the sheet follows but a page can override; there is no fixed threshold that holds for every face.

bg.reason: the effective background of the page body

surface.reason: the most used opaque background near the page ground

text.reason: the strongest of the common text colors against the page ground

muted.reason: the most used text color after the main one, distinct from it

accent.reason: the most saturated color weighted by how often it appears

accentText.reason: whichever of text or bg reads better on the accent

accentInk.reason: the accent reads on the ground as is

violet.reason: the next saturated color with a different hue

danger.reason: a saturated red already in use, nudged to read on the ground

type.reason: 102 text elements use 12.8px; a ratio of 1.25 covers 100 percent of text

space.reason: 100 percent of spacing lands on 4px, 34 percent on 8px

radius.reason: the three most used radii, smallest to largest

motion.reason: the shortest, the most used and the longest duration in use

density.reason: the median of 40 control heights, snapped to the grid
